content.en_us: Extremely cold liquid. Usable as a combustion fuel, as well as in many recipes, such as [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]], in the [[hydrotreater|Hydrotreater]] or in the [[particle accelerator|Particle Accelerator]]. Can be made from water, either in a [[chemical plant|Chemical Plant]] or [[electrolyzer|Electrolysis Machine]].
